- Time: \(O(H r^2) for Telea and Navier-Stokes, a sparse solve for biharmonic\)
- Memory: \(O(N)\)

N is the number of pixels, H the number of hole pixels and r the radius. Biharmonic solves a sparse linear system with one unknown per hole pixel, which is slower for large holes.
